metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for single URL fetch with timeout in thread-safe context. It does not semantically match any existing skill (Image Component Optimization and Custom Reward Function Design are unrelated domains). Peer candidates (Future State Polling, Executor Submit, Future Exception Inspection) are complementary concurrent.futures patterns at the same granularity but represent different capabilities in the async task lifecycle. Candidate fills a gap as the actual I/O operation layer that would be submitted via the Executor Submit skill.
